prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic five-panel Y2K-inspired fashion collection in pink bedroom and studio settings, with consistent adult styling, playful color blocking and social-media-ready composition.
prompt.main_subject: Five clearly adult women with original non-celebrity identities, each in a distinct fashion look. Panel 1: long wavy red-haired adult in a yellow-and-green checkered corset with secure coverage, yellow plaid pleated mini skirt, white fishnet tights, yellow socks and light-green platform heels in a wooden-bed pink-bedding bedroom, mirror-selfie style. Panel 2: the same red-haired adult in a black corset with silver closures, black pleated mini skirt, white fishnet tights, yellow socks and black patent platform heels in the same bedroom, edited-color mirror-selfie style. Panel 3: adult with brown pigtails and colorful hair accessories in a teal sleeveless top with a generic cute-cat graphic, pink-and-blue checked shorts, pink knit arm warmers, white tights and colorful clips in a pink canopy-bed studio. Panel 4: adult blonde with high pigtails in a royal-blue sleeveless top with the same generic cute-cat graphic, matching blue shorts, pink arm warmers, yellow tights and star hair clips in a softly lit pink bedroom. Panel 5: adult with dark high pigtails and bangs in a brown sleeveless top with generic cute-cat graphic, green-and-pink checked shorts, pink arm warmers, pastel choker and star clips in a pink-themed bedroom. Keep all clothing opaque, secure and naturally proportioned. Do not reproduce Sadie Sink, Dua Lipa, Sydney Sweeney, Jenna Ortega or any other public figure.
prompt.composition_elements: Arrange five coordinated vertical panels or carousel images with one adult subject per panel, consistent Y2K styling language and clear outfit-color separation. Preserve mirror-selfie framing for the first two panels and aesthetic studio portrait framing for panels three through five. Maintain pink bedding, wooden bed frame, canopy bed and soft pink bedroom settings as specified. Replace branded character graphics with a generic cute-cat graphic and omit logos.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Use soft pink-room lighting and gentle studio illumination with playful color accents, realistic fabric and hair detail, subtle nostalgic Y2K grain and coherent skin tones across all five panels. Keep the mood sweet, spicy, colorful and playful rather than sexualized.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic five-panel fashion collection, vertical social-media framing, consistent adult identity per panel, realistic corset, knit, plaid, tights, platform shoes, bedding and hair-accessory textures, balanced color grading, no readable text, logos or watermark.
